bullets.text: UK Protects Undersea Networks - The UK commits to safeguarding critical undersea networks amid rising threats from **Russia** and **China**.
T-Mobile's F1 5G Partnership - **T-Mobile US** extends its exclusive 5G partnership with **Formula 1**, enhancing fan experiences.
AI Transformation Essential for Telcos - **Telcos** face extinction without adopting AI technologies, warns industry expert Abhishek Sandhir.
UK Funds European Satellite Projects - The **UK Space Agency** supports five satellite projects through the **ESA's ARTES** programme.
Fibre Broadband Competition in the UK - The UK must secure long-term competition for digital infrastructure to avoid stagnation.
Nokia's Job Cuts in Germany - **Nokia** plans to close its Munich site, resulting in 700 job losses as part of restructuring.
GSMA Warns of Spectrum Crunch - The **GSMA** highlights urgent need for spectrum planning to avoid congestion in future **6G** networks.
Meta Completes 2Africa Cable - **Meta** announces completion of the 2Africa subsea cable, enhancing connectivity across Africa and beyond.
